head: dbaf88ec7165ae8547d2756407583c04b3ead27b
body:
Additional dependency review at `dbaf88ec7165ae8547d2756407583c04b3ead27b` found integration-blocking issues beyond the two k8 receipt updates:

- `k8-rank7-composition/reproduce.py::sources` compares `sha(root/rel)` directly to each `main_files` value. The new auditor entry is a dict, so this always rejects. Its `native` stage also executes that auditor: it needs a live string digest, not a provenance-only exemption.
- `u8-e4-gap-fill/support.py::validate_sources` has the same string-versus-dict failure; `native.py` executes the auditor.
- `k8-rank7-composition/MANIFEST.json` and `u8-terminal-cone-census/MANIFEST.json` still hash the pre-change `SOURCES.json`, so their package integrity checks reject.

Please revise the complete dependency closure: keep actual runtime inputs hashed, preserve historical provenance separately, refresh dependent manifest/receipt bindings, and run the affected source-pin checks plus an input-only export. The two k8 input fixes are being checked locally, but they do not resolve the wider closure. The integer-row differential tests are passing; this is a production integration blocker, not a reported mathematical counterexample. Keeping this PR open for that revision.
